artworks.title: Travellers among Roman Ruins
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with red-brown and blue wash, indented with stylus
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a view of ancient ruins in an oval frame, capturing a high perspective. The horizon is positioned high with remnants of towers and structures merging with the sky. Brushstrokes depict detailed textures of the architecture and surrounding foliage. The color palette consists of earthy tones, with hints of blues in the sky. Small figures walk along a path near the ruins, adding scale and life to the scene. In the distance, archways and walls fade into the sky.

artworks.title: View near Rosora di Serra San Quirico
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened in white on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Stoddard M. Stevens Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with hills, a row of trees along the horizon, a brick structure with medieval architecture, natural elements like hills and trees extending into the distance, a curving path leading to the structure, a river with animals nearby, and two small figures walking along the path. The painting is detailed, featuring different brushstrokes for foliage and land/water, and uses a sepia color palette with dark browns for shadows and lighter tones for open areas.

artworks.title: Studies of Market Figures
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various scenes involving wagons and horses. The image depicts numerous figures engaged in everyday activities, with a variety of wagons drawn by horses scattered throughout the scene. The composition is busy, showcasing individuals in different poses, some interacting with each other, while others are seen carrying goods or tending to their animals. The sketch includes intricate details of the wagons, horses, and items being carried or transported, rendered in fine pencil or ink lines. The overall impression is lively, capturing a snapshot of daily life with a focus on movement and the bustle of a community.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Apollonia
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened with white over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures in intense interaction, some nude or partially clothed. The composition shows dynamic motion, with figures contorting and reaching out in various gestures. The central focus is a struggle or confrontation between the figures, with one figure pierced by a spear or sword, while others seem to assist or oppose. Above them floats a cherubic or angelic figure with wings. The scene is monochromatic, using shades of brown ink and washes on a cream background, giving it a classical feel. The drawing conveys tension and movement through the interplay of figures and the use of shadow and highlight.

artworks.title: Mrs. Richard Brinsley Sheridan
artworks.artist: Samuel Arlent Edwards after Thomas Gainsborough
artworks.creditLine: Gift of S. Arlent Edwards, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated, facing forward. She is wearing a light-colored dress with three-quarter length sleeves and a red sash around her waist. Her hand rests on her lap. She has dark, curly hair tied with a red ribbon and a sheer scarf over her shoulders. The background features lush foliage, water, and a colorful sky. The portrait is contained within an oval frame.

artworks.title: Harbor in Holland - Flushing (La balise - En Holland, Flessingue)
artworks.medium: etching in blue-green on laid paper
artworks.description: The low vantage point shows a rowboat on the right and a large triangular structure on the left, with the water in the foreground and buildings in the distance. The etching technique captures the scene with detailed lines. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of blue.

artworks.title: Cattle and Figures at a Farmyard Stream
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a body of water, cattle drinking, a thatched-roof structure, abundant trees, rolling hills, buildings in the distance, a person on horseback, and a winding path. The engraving has finely detailed textures in varying shades of grayscale, depicting a classic and serene landscape with a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son Squandering His Inheritance on Harlots
artworks.artist: Dirck Volckertz Coornhert after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered together in an intricate scene. The figures are wearing classical attire and are positioned around a seated central figure. The figures have expressive postures. The background features an architectural setting with an archway leading to an outdoor scene. Additionally, there is a table with a decorative pitcher, a stringed instrument, and foliage. The use of line work creates texture and depth.

artworks.title: Joseph Awakened by the Angel
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.7 x 18.9 cm (5 3/8 x 7 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays an etching featuring a woman standing or kneeling on the right side, with her body slightly turned, head lowered, and hands holding a swaddled infant. Her head is covered with a draped cloth, and she is wearing flowing robes. On the left side, there are figures, one of which seems to have wings. The scene is set in a rustic setting with animals in the foreground, including a donkey. The background is sketched with lines and hatching for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Antwerp Cathedral
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 48.6 x 33.6 cm (19 1/8 x 13 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a cathedral in the center, surrounded by other buildings and people below. The cathedral is intricately detailed with fine lines, set against a monochrome color palette of black and grey. The sky has clouds, adding to the grandeur of the scene.

artworks.title: Cite Lointaine
artworks.description: The image depicts a aerial view of a landscape with a valley between rocky cliffs. The scene includes a cityscape in the distance, detailed and textured etching depicting rocks, water, and vegetation, a monochromatic sepia color palette, a body of water with surrounding tall grasses, buildings in the distance, and a sky with soft clouds.

artworks.title: At the Prado (Au Prado)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on japanese paper
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures, primarily focusing on one person in the foreground. This person is depicted from head to toe, standing upright with a slight turn of the body to their right. Their facial features are gently sketched with a soft expression, and their hair is mostly covered by a large, dark headscarf or hood. Their clothing is a long, dark, full-skirted garment that covers them entirely down to the ground. One of their hands is visible and holds a dark object, possibly a bag or a muff, and the other hand holds what appears to be a light-colored handkerchief or similar item. Surrounding the central figure, there are other individuals in the background wearing hats and dark clothing, seemingly forming a gathering or procession. The background is textured with dark, abstract shapes, set against a light sky. Two small poodle-like dogs are at the feet of the central figure.

artworks.title: Saint-Etienne-du-Mont, Paris (Church of St. Stephen of the Mount, Paris)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene featuring a historic church or cathedral. The image displays gothic architecture with detailed elements, such as stone carvings, arched windows, a large circular window, and a central clock tower. Additional buildings with elaborate facades flank the structure. Construction activity is shown with scaffolding on one side. The line work is precise and fine, creating textures and shadows. The drawing captures the beauty and intricacy of the architecture, evoking a sense of timelessness and reverence for historical design.

artworks.title: La Modiste (The Milliner)
artworks.description: The image is an illustration depicting a group of individuals, primarily women, interacting in a scene set in a hat shop. The women are trying on or examining hats, with some standing and adjusting their hair or accessories. They are stylized with simple facial features and hairstyles of buns or tight pulls, wearing dark, elegant, floor-length dresses. The scene includes hat stands displaying various styles, a large mirror being used by some to view the hats, and additional people in the background. The design is minimalistic, focusing on the interplay of black and white space.

artworks.title: Comedie de la Mort
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a landscape with skeletal figures and trees. The scene shows skeletons among gnarled trees. The sky has detailed clouds, and there is a body of water reflecting the scenery. Bones and skulls are scattered throughout the scene, creating an eerie atmosphere. The composition conveys death and decay with surreal elements.

artworks.title: Samson and Delilah
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures engaged in a dramatic scene. The composition includes a group of characters with expressive faces and postures, gathered around a central figure who appears to be in distress. This figure is kneeling at the forefront, surrounded by others who are either supporting or restraining him. There is a sense of tension and movement in the image, with individuals leaning in or pulling away. The setting includes architectural elements in the background, such as walls or columns, and a hint of a landscape with distant structures visible. The use of fine lines and shading creates depth and texture, enhancing the emotions conveyed through the characters' interactions and the narrative moment captured. The style of this drawing is likely influenced by classical or Renaissance art traditions, emphasizing human anatomy and drama.

artworks.title: Saint Amond
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.7 × 29.1 cm (8 15/16 × 11 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical gathering in a forest setting. The artwork depicts a scene where a figure with a radiant halo is speaking to a crowd seated or standing attentively in a semicircle. The background includes trees, foliage, and a distant building, adding depth to the composition. The detailed line work and shading show textures of the surroundings and people's attire, creating a vivid representation of a serene event in nature.

artworks.title: Michel Baron
artworks.artist: Jean Daullé after François de Troy
artworks.description: This image shows the upper half of a person seated. The person has long, curly hair, a prominent nose, and eyes looking ahead. They are wearing a robe with a large collar and lace accents near the wrists. Their hands are folded in front of them. The background is a simple, darkened backdrop. There are no visible accessories or objects. The portrait is framed by borders with writing, indicating it may be part of a formal document or art piece.

artworks.title: Louis XV
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of a man viewed from the waist up. He faces slightly to the right, with his head turned further towards his right shoulder, presenting a side profile. The man has curly hair framing his head and falling to the nape of his neck, tied with a ribbon. He has a straight nose, defined lips, and a strong jawline. The man is dressed in elaborate armor with a decorative sash over his shoulder. He is within an oval frame or cartouche, with a textured background. Below the image is the inscription "Louis Quinze."

artworks.title: Louis XV
artworks.artist: Jean Daullé after Jean-Baptiste Lemoyne II
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring a half-length portrait of a man in formal attire. He is positioned elegantly, looking slightly to his left. The man has distinct facial features such as a well-defined nose, prominent eyebrows, and full lips, with his eyes facing forward. His hair is styled in curls that frame his face and extend towards the back. He is wearing decorated armor with intricate detailing and a sash across his chest, along with a ruffled cravat around his neck. The background shows a clear sky with some clouds, and the image is framed within an ornate oval border bearing the inscription "Louis XV."

artworks.title: Louis le Bien Aime
artworks.artist: Pierre-François Basan after Jean-Baptiste Lemoyne II
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man in a loose-fitting, hooded garment sitting cross-legged on the ground. He rests one arm on a large oval frame displaying a portrait of another man. The elderly man has a bushy beard and his hair is mostly covered by the hood. He has a neutral expression, looking outward. The man in the oval frame is depicted from the waist up, wearing detailed clothing with a vest, sash, ribbons, and a medal. The background includes a large tree, a lantern in the man's hand, a book near the tree roots, flowers, foliage, a coat of arms, and decorative natural elements. The image is embellished with text and script at the bottom.

artworks.title: Louis XV
artworks.artist: Nicolas de Larmessin IV after Hyacinthe Rigaud
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a young person facing slightly to the right. The person is in a seated position, with a three-quarter view highlighting their right shoulder. Their facial features are youthful with gentle eyes and a small, closed-mouth smile. They have long, wavy hair falling down to their shoulders and are elegantly dressed in a regal outfit with intricate designs and ornate lace at the collar. They wear a fur-lined or ermine-trimmed mantle. The person is wearing a sash across their chest and is framed by a large oval against a backdrop of richly embroidered drapery with fleur-de-lis patterns. At the base of the frame, there is an elaborate crest featuring a crown and fleur-de-lis motifs, and the background contains architectural details.

artworks.title: The Honest Model
artworks.medium: gouache and graphite on vellum, mounted on paperboard

artworks.title: A King and His Retinue Confronting Ladies under a Celestial Battle
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene with angelic and human figures against a cityscape. The drawing features a dramatic arrangement of figures, both celestial and terrestrial. At the top, winged angelic beings are depicted. Below them, a detailed expanse of a medieval city sprawls across the horizon. In the foreground, armored figures appear to be in discussion, standing near elegantly dressed individuals gathered under a tree. The scene captures a blend of supernatural and earthly realms amidst the architectural backdrop. The artist paid significant attention to detail, giving the drawing a rich, textured appearance.
